title.en: How plants and animals depend on each other

text.en: Wherever there are plants, there are animals too, living on, around and even under the plants.

Look carefully at plants. Many animals live on, around and under them.
Elephants feed on grass. A moth rests on a leaf. A caterpillar chews a leaf. Earthworms live in the soil.
A tailorbird sings on a tree. A woodpecker pecks on a trunk. Ants build their nest using leaves.
A frog rests on a leaf. A barbet makes a nest in a tree hollow. Squirrels use tree hollows to hide and rest.
Animals choose plants for food, shelter and rest. Plants also gain, for example when insects help flowers (additional, not in the textbook).
Use your hands and arms to show how big or small these animals are.
